title_zh: 商定缺课学生的补课任务调整

scenario.label_zh: 为缺课学生调整补课任务
scenario.goal_zh: 核对缺课范围，决定先与学生私下商量缩小补做任务并延后提交

context_zh: 虚构中学中，家长与教师讨论十六岁学生的缺课安排。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Maya was absent on Monday and Tuesday. She's worried that she has to redo every classroom activity.

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: Her absence means she missed the demonstration, but not the start of a new topic. A small adjustment should be enough.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: As an adolescent, she wants to manage this herself. Could you discuss the plan with her rather than announce it to the class?

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: Of course. I'll ask her to watch the demonstration recording and complete just the two related questions.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Could she hand them in on Friday instead of tomorrow?

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: Yes. I'll offer that deadline when I speak to her privately today.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Thank you. I'll let her know you'll talk with her, not that every detail has already been settled for her.
